name: College of Dance (Bard Subclass - 2024)
description: Bards of the College of Dance weave magic and movement, enhancing their AC, unarmed strikes, and inspiring allies through dazzling performances.
source: RPGBOT 2024 College of Dance Bard Subclass Guide (PHB)

3.name: Dazzling Footwork
3.description: You gain four benefits: Permanent Advantage on Performance checks involving dancing. Add Charisma modifier to AC when not wearing medium/heavy armor or shield. When a creature uses your Bardic Inspiration die, they can also add the roll to the damage of their next weapon attack or unarmed strike within 1 minute. Your unarmed strikes can use Dexterity for attack/damage and deal damage equal to your Bardic Inspiration die; when you use Attack action for unarmed strike, can make one as a bonus action.

6.name: Inspiring Movement
6.description: When a creature uses one of your Bardic Inspiration dice, you can use your reaction to move up to your speed without provoking opportunity attacks. If you end this move within 5 feet of a creature, you can make one unarmed strike against it.

6.name: Tandem Footwork
6.description: When you roll initiative, you can expend one Bardic Inspiration die, roll it, and grant that many allies (up to your proficiency bonus) who can see or hear you a bonus to their initiative equal to the number rolled.

14.name: Leading Evasion
14.description: When you or an ally within 30 feet that can see or hear you is subjected to an effect that allows a Dexterity saving throw for half damage, you can use your reaction to grant that creature the benefits of Evasion (no damage on success, half damage on failure).
